_comment: Placeholders only. Script Properties are set in Apps Script › Project Settings › Script Properties (one key per row, value without the surrounding quotes). Never commit real values. Keys starting with _ are comments, do not add them.
SESSION_SECRET: <created by Expedition admin › Set up — leave unset and let the menu generate it>
SESSION_VERSIONS: <managed by the script — do not create, edit or delete>
ALLOWED_DESTINATION_IDS: <optional, e.g. D01,D02,D03 — leave unset to allow every destination in Destinations.gs>
NOVELTY_DATA: <optional JSON, e.g. {"D01":{"newToAll":true,"visitedCount":0,"visitedBy":[],"note":""}} — leave unset if unknown>
SHEET_NAMESPACE: <optional, e.g. TEST_ while testing; remove for real use>
